titulo: Trump praises back-to-back meetings with Zelenskyy and Netanyahu
cuerpo: US president makes positive posts as Ukraine seeks more firepower and Israeli PM seeks to repair relationship Donald Trump hosted back-to-back White House meetings with Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Benjamin Netanyahu on Tuesday, as Ukraine seeks more firepower for its air defenses and the Israeli prime minister tries to repair his strained relationship with the US president. Trump described both meetings in positive terms on social media Tuesday evening, remaining vague about what was discussed. Continue reading...
